compiled_evidence.claim: Main calls run(1) before MPI_Wtime and run(iterations) between timer calls; GpuSpmv::run has a counted launch loop and both scalar and warp launch branches in the cited method body.

compiled_evidence.claim: The scalar and warp PTX entries show CSR loads and fma operations; these PTX ranges do not stand in for the SASS branch evidence.

The warp entry performs sparse loads and DFMA, with a backward branch in its traversal at line 701 (0x1540 to 0x01c0); the scalar entry performs DFMA at line 952 and branches backward at line 954 (0x0300 to 0x0230).

notes: The extra run(1) is outside timing. Ranks with empty local slices launch no row work. Repeated same-input A*x/output overwrite is prescribed behavior.
